pitch_en: Sustainability consultancy connecting businesses with certified waste networks, and developing a platform for regenerative tourism destination management in Colombia.
pitch_es: Consultora de sostenibilidad que conecta empresas con redes certificadas de gestión de residuos, y desarrolla una plataforma para la gestión de destinos de turismo regenerativo.
cta_pitch_en: Simbiotic connects clients with certified waste networks and builds digital platforms (including ADN Sostenible and Triply) for regenerative tourism destination management.
cta_pitch_es: Simbiotic conecta clientes con redes certificadas de residuos y construye plataformas digitales (incluidas ADN Sostenible y Triply) para gestión de destinos de turismo regenerativo.

sections.head_en: Companies and tourism destinations lack integrated tools to manage waste responsibly and measure sustainability performance across value chains.
sections.head_es: Las empresas y destinos turísticos carecen de herramientas integradas para gestionar residuos responsablemente y medir desempeño de sostenibilidad en cadenas de valor.
